test_policy.notes: Freshman page: applicants with a weighted high school GPA of 2.50 up to (not including) 2.80 must submit an ACT of 17+ or SAT of 930+; no test requirement is listed for other applicants. The international page says SAT/ACT is required if the calculated GPA is between 2.5 and 2.8 (GPA must be at least 2.5).

requirements.notes: Apply through the Broncoville portal, NC Connect (CFNC) or Choose NC; $50 non-refundable fee. Letters of recommendation are not required. International applicants also need transcripts with a course-by-course evaluation and GPA calculation from a NACES member (Atlas Credential Evaluations also accepted) and financial documents: the page says proof of funding for at least one academic year for admission, and, in a separate section, four academic years for the I-20; confirm with the Office of International Programs.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 first-year application deadline (general; no separate international date published)
deadlines.notes: The dates page, titled for Spring, Summer and Fall 2027, lists July 30 for fall first-year applicants. No separate international undergraduate deadline is printed (the only international deadline listed is March 1 for graduate applicants), so confirm timing for the I-20 with the Office of International Programs.

deadlines.label: Scholarship application deadline (portal opens October 31, 2026)
deadlines.notes: First-year applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships; whether international students qualify is not stated.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The international page lists English proficiency scores '(If applicable)' and prints no exemption list. An older International Education Center page says a TOEFL report is required unless the applicant is from an official English-speaking country (countries not listed on that page).

english.notes: Paper-based minimum 500. No 1-6 band value is given.

aid.notes: The international page lists no institutional international scholarships; it points to a Scholarship Opportunities page for external funding for admitted international students. FSU merit scholarships for first-time freshmen (Platinum $5,000, Gold $3,000, Silver $2,000 per year for unweighted GPA 3.75+, 3.50-3.74, 3.2-3.49) need no extra application, but the pages do not say whether international students qualify. International students are eligible for the NC Promise tuition rate.

cost.notes: NC Promise (starts fall 2027, international students eligible, no extra application): out-of-state undergraduate tuition $4,000 per semester, so $8,000 for two semesters. Fees $1,726, health insurance $1,312 and a traditional-dorm room and board estimate of $3,500 are printed per semester (the figures here are doubled for two semesters; health insurance, $2,624 for the year, is not included). The page's per-semester total for out-of-state students living on campus is $10,538 (2027-2028 rates).

sat.note: SAT code printed on the freshman admission page.

act.note: ACT code printed on the freshman admission page.

toefl.note: TOEFL school code printed on an older International Education Center admissions page; scores must be sent electronically.
